verdict.rationale: Alloy's transaction monitoring workflows document that they can 'generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met', so the product has its own alert and investigation objects. Nothing in the evidence shows analysts prioritizing alerts or grouping related subjects and transactions into an investigation. Entity merging is about identity resolution, an adjacent feature, and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: alert prioritization or triage queues, grouping multiple subjects and transactions into one investigation, case-management workflow docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can prioritize alerts and group relevant subjects and transactions into an investigation

citations.quote: Monitors transaction events in real time or at scheduled times to detect suspicious activity, apply policy logic, and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met.
